description: Ask a natural-language question and receive structured intelligence context retrieved from Tresslers Group dossiers via RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation). Returns relevant document chunks, source citations, conviction metadata, and graph neighborhood data. The calling LLM should synthesize the returned context into a coherent answer.

max_sources.description: Maximum number of source dossier chunks to retrieve (default 5, max 8).

question.description: Natural language question (e.g., 'What are the key geopolitical risks in sovereign AI policy?').

name: ask_intelligence_rag

text.description: Structured RAG response object with chunks, source citations, conviction metadata, and graph neighborhood.
